stages.english: In C, a single equals sign assigns a value to a variable. A double equals sign compares values for equality, so distinguish an equality test from an accidental assignment in a condition.
stages.chinese: In C, a single equals sign assigns a value to a variable. A double equals sign compares values for equality, so distinguish an equality test from an accidental assignment in a condition.

stages.english: When both operands have integer type, division discards the fractional part by truncating toward zero. Convert an operand to a floating-point type before division if you want a floating-point result; converting only the result cannot bring back the discarded fraction.
stages.chinese: When both operands have integer type, division discards the fractional part by truncating toward zero. Convert an operand to a floating-point type before division if you want a floating-point result; converting only the result cannot bring back the discarded fraction.

stages.english: A C string is a sequence of characters ending with the null character, written '\0'. The terminator marks the end, and strlen reports the byte length before it without counting that terminator.
stages.chinese: A C string is a sequence of characters ending with the null character, written '\0'. The terminator marks the end, and strlen reports the byte length before it without counting that terminator.

stages.english: A return statement hands a result back to the caller of a function. Printing a result displays it for the user; printing it is a different operation from returning that result to the caller.
stages.chinese: A return statement hands a result back to the caller of a function. Printing a result displays it for the user; printing it is a different operation from returning that result to the caller.
